original_test_intent: Verify that each applicable Type 17 Configured Voltage reports the approved configured module voltage in millivolts, or zero as Unknown under policy, lies within known supported minimum/maximum values and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records with SMBIOS version/length; gate the field by schema, bind its raw 16-bit value to locator/module identity, decode zero versus millivolts, compare approved configuration and minimum/maximum envelope, and repeat after reboot without changing voltage.
manual_activity: A user approves expected configured voltage and reboot plan. No BIOS write, rail adjustment or electrical measurement is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected configured voltage per populated locator/device class
Applicable SMBIOS version and minimum Type 17 length
Policy for raw zero Unknown and empty records
Expected supported minimum/maximum envelope and configuration source
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/BIOS/BMC/inventory; never change memory voltage or firmware.
Gate the field by formatted length and retain raw millivolts.
Interpret zero as Unknown, not an applied 0 V state.
When known, require minimum <= configured <= maximum and compare the approved configured value.
Do not claim the declared value is live measured telemetry; stop on ambiguity or reboot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate field presence, raw zero/mV semantics, configured baseline and envelope ordering, then compare pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not change BIOS settings, apply voltage or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve configured voltage, supported envelope and Unknown/applicability policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, interpret firmware-versus-board configuration conflicts and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove structure length, locator, raw zero semantics or supported-envelope relationship.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 17 data; report locator/module identity, structure length, raw configured value, Unknown/normalized mV and min/configured/max ordering.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Configured voltage scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and voltage/BIOS changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate Configured Voltage by Type 17 length, decode raw zero/millivolts, compare the approved setting and min/max envelope, and repeat after reboot using read-only evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 implementations containing module voltage fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and module-spec versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 voltage-field definitions and authoritative BIOS/platform/module voltage policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds schema presence, raw zero, locator identity and complete supported-envelope comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects absent/truncated fields, Unknown misread as 0 V, wrong-slot configuration and configured values outside supported bounds.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-device configured voltage and envelope/applicability policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: This is firmware-declared configuration metadata; live voltage tolerance and transient behavior require separate telemetry or instrumentation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different voltages by memory technology or topology, but must key them to device class/locator; a board rail reading cannot silently replace the SMBIOS configured-value requirement.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator configured voltage and envelope/zero/applicability policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records with SMBIOS version/length
Per-device raw configured value, Unknown/normalized mV and envelope result
Read-only BIOS/BMC/board context clearly separated from live-sensor claims
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic configured-voltage diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Configured voltage is a defined companion field; expected configuration and envelope are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Schema, numeric and envelope checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds field presence, raw zero, device identity and min/configured/max validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-write safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates declared configuration from live telemetry and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an isolated decoded configured value from passing when absent, Unknown, assigned to the wrong module or outside its supported envelope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Field presence, raw mV decoding and ordering/baseline comparisons are deterministic software operations without voltage stimulus.
